description: This file defines an abstract class 'FSDPExtensions' providing hooks for customization of Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) operations in PyTorch. It includes functions for tensor transformations, sharding, and tensor gathering related to distributed training, specifically for FSDP extensions. The file is part of the torch.distributed.fsdp._fsdp_extensions module, implementing extension points for tensor parallelism and sharded tensor management.

classes.name: FSDPExtensions
classes.description: An abstract base class providing customizable hooks to integrate tensor parallelism and sharding in PyTorch's FSDP framework.

methods.name: tuple[torch.Tensor,Any|None] pre_flatten_transform( self, tensor: torch.Tensor, )
methods.description: Converts a distributed tensor to a local tensor, e.g., from DistributedTensor to local tensor.

methods.name: torch.Tensor post_unflatten_transform( self, tensor: torch.Tensor, param_extension: Any, )
methods.description: Converts a local tensor back to a distributed tensor, e.g., to DistributedTensor.

methods.name: torch.Tensor chunk_tensor( self, tensor: torch.Tensor, rank: int, world_size: int, num_devices_per_node: int, pg: dist.ProcessGroup, device: torch.device | None = None, )
methods.description: Shards a tensor into chunks distributed across processes.

methods.name: torch.Tensor chunk_dtensor( self, tensor: torch.Tensor, rank: int, device_mesh: DeviceMesh, )
methods.description: Shards a tensor or DTensor to a DTensor in a device mesh.

methods.name: tuple[torch.Tensor,list[Shard]] pre_load_state_dict_transform( self, tensor: torch.Tensor, )
methods.description: Prepares tensors for loading a sharded model state dictionary by returning the tensor and corresponding shards.

methods.name: torch.Tensor all_gather_dtensor( self, tensor: DTensor, parent_mesh: DeviceMesh | None, )
methods.description: Gathers a DTensor in the context of sharded tensor state dict loading.
